name: @kitstak/pulse-bridge
description: Shared-database bridge into KitStak Pulse (the pulse schema) for Portal, CRM, WMS and Projects: job profit for a linked record, client profit, workspace totals, the Pulse role of a person, deep links and change events. Works over any Drizzle Postgres executor. Reads never throw and report 'not available' when Pulse is absent. TypeScript source-shipped (consumers transpile via Next transpilePackages).
